basis: Malignant neoplasm involving the stomach; no additional organ involvement is established across this umbrella.
Abnormal, incomplete development of one kidney defines the disease.
Thymic epithelial carcinoma; thymus has no specified anatomical axis. Carcinoma alone does not meet the infectious_immune mechanism definition.
Progressive degeneration of frontal and temporal brain regions causes dementia, behavioral changes and language impairment.
Inherited susceptibility to breast cancer; breast is outside the axes, and susceptibility does not establish damage elsewhere.
Carcinoma originates in cutaneous sweat glands, sebaceous glands or hair follicles.
Leukodystrophy with cerebral white matter disease and progressive neurologic impairment. Dysphagia reflects neurologic dysfunction, not separate gastrointestinal damage.
Premature metopic suture fusion defines the cranial bone disorder. Developmental delay is occasional; papilledema and raised intracranial pressure occur in 1–4%.
Ovarian germ cell malignancy; reproductive organs are outside the axes, and endocrine dysfunction is not defining.
Squamous carcinoma originates in oral mucosa. HPV association does not make the carcinoma itself an infectious disease.
Inherited lysosomal lipid degradation disorder; organ damage varies substantially among subtypes, with no additional organ established across most of the umbrella.
ID, fifth-digit hypoplasia and characteristic hair/nail abnormalities define CSS. Visual impairment 5/11; hearing loss 4/12 and cleft palate 4/12 omitted by cap.
Localized dermal/subcutaneous fibrous thickening over knuckles; location over joints does not establish joint disease.
Malignant neoplasm of the submandibular salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Disrupted carbohydrate transport defines a metabolic disease; additional organ damage depends on the specific transport disorder.
Acinic cell carcinoma originates in the parotid salivary gland.
Psychotic and mood disorder without defining damage to an organ axis; purely psychiatric conditions are excluded.
Autoinflammatory disease establishes the immune mechanism axis; the supplied evidence does not establish common direct damage to another organ.
Renal tubular sodium transport disorder defined by hypertension, hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis; all were present in 2/2 reported patients.
Definition specifies carcinoma arising in perianal skin; anal location alone does not establish intestinal mucosal involvement.
Excess pancreatic insulin secretion causes recurrent hypoglycemia. Hypoglycemic seizures occur in 2/5, but persistent neurologic damage is not established at ≥30%.
Corneal pigmentation is itself a localized corneal disorder; ocular is its primary anatomical axis.
Carcinoma originates in the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the axes. HPV is a risk factor rather than an immune mechanism of the carcinoma.
Cardiac conduction defects and characteristic hand phalangeal malformations jointly define this heart-hand syndrome.
Hepatic porphyrin metabolism disorder with defining cutaneous disease; the hepatic origin and skin manifestations identify its primary axes.
